benefits_features.Milestone benefits: When you spend Rs. 20,00,000 or more in one year, you get the next membership renewed for free next year.
benefits_features.Travel Privileges:
Preferential access to more than 1,000 airport lounges in India and across the world with the complimentary Priority Pass Membership and Mastercard Airport Access Program. 
Primary and add-on cardholders can have access to facilities like spa, restaurants and the business center.
Cardholders get complimentary lounge access to more than 1,000 airport lounges with the Mastercard Airport Access Program.
The card comes with foreign currency markup of only 2% on all spends made outside the country.
benefits_features.Lifestyle Benefits:
Customized hotel bookings, dining reservations, movie ticket booking and much more can be done with ease via your personal concierge service. To contact the service, cardholders can call 1800 100 1887 or 022 62332222.
Enjoy complimentary gold passes at some of the best golf courses in India and across the world with the Infinia credit card.
To get in the swing at domestic and international golf courses, visit and avail of the website of HDFC Bank.
With the card, get access to exclusive discounts at select golf courses in the country.
The primary cardholder will receive 2000 green fee waivers during the year.
Infinia cardholders receive complimentary Club Marriott membership.
benefits_features.Dining Benefits:
With the HDFC Infinia credit card, get exclusive offers and discounts of up to 15% at more than 3000 participating restaurants.
Enjoy a discount of up to 20% on food and beverages at restaurants in Marriott Hotels.
Make the most of the membership with up to 30% off on Best Available Rates on more at Marriott Hotels in India on Weekday Rates in Marriott Hotels in the Asia Pacific.
benefits_features.Financial Benefits:
HDFC Bank Infinia credit card offers the lowest foreign currency markup fee at just 2% plus GST on all foreign transactions.
The convenience fee of 2% is waived off at all transactions. The minimum transaction value is Rs. 5000, the maximum waiver offered is Rs. 1,000/per statement cycle.
The HDFC Bank Credit Card comes with an interest-free period of up to 50 days.
The primary cardholder can withdraw up to 40% of the credit limit without any cash withdrawal charges.
benefits_features.Insurance Benefits:
Get a clutch in an air accident, the accidental hospital bill will receive insurance compensation of Rs. 50 Lakh.
The primary cardholder is also well insured with medical insurance of Rs. 8.50 Lakh with road-side assistance.
The extraordinary amount of HDFC Bank’s Infinia credit card will be recovered to an extent of Rs. 50 Lakh in the case of permanent disability of the primary cardholder or accidental death.
benefits_features.Reward Point Benefits:
With this card, you will have access to one of the best rewards programs offered by the bank.
Get reward points for every Rs. 150 spent on the card with no conditions attached.
Earn up to 50 times Reward Points on travel and shopping spends on particular.
Enjoy 25 reward points on every Rs. 1500 spent on booking movie tickets on this website, online flight and booking tickets on the website of Air Vistara.
Make the most of your reward points and convert them to Air Miles. These miles can be exchanged for tickets and services with leading domestic and international airlines.
The reward points have a lifetime of 3 years from the date of accumulation.

how_tos.How to Redeem Reward Points Earned on HD:
You can redeem reward points through offline and online methods. If you plan to do it offline, you will need to visit the website and download the reward points redemption form. After filling the form, it needs to be sent to the following address:
HDFC Bank Cards Division,
P.O. Box No 1696,
Thoraipakkam P.O.,
Chennai - 600044.
To redeem the reward points online, here are the steps which need to be followed:
- Log in to your HDFC Credit Card net banking.
- Click on the ‘Credit Cards’ tab.
- You will need to register your credit card.
- Once you do, click on ‘Redeem Reward Points’.
- Select your card and then click on ‘Continue’.
- The website will redirect you to a different page.
- Select your point/air mile category from the range of different categories.
- Click on the items to be purchased and it will be added to your cart.
- Once done, click on the ‘Shopping cart’ to check out the items.
- Check the box to indicate that you have read the terms and conditions.
- Click on ‘redeem’ and submit.

faqs.1. What is the interest-free period on m: You enjoy an interest-free period of up to 50 days.
faqs.2. How much is the limit of cash I can w: You can withdraw up to 40% of the credit limit with your Infinia Credit Card.
faqs.3. How do I get access to Priority Pass: You will receive your Priority Pass Membership as part of the welcome kit along with your Infinia credit card. Follow the instructions to activate your membership and present the card at any participating airport lounge to get access.
faqs.4. Will I earn Reward Points for EasyEMI: No. Loan, EMI transactions and any transaction related to paying off your credit will not earn any Reward Points.
